Even though this work has high production, smooth fighting scenes, pleasing character design and full of masculinity, plot is just a group of delinquents fighting.

This is what I thought before watching episode 9 and 10 of anime.

Didn’t expect it could present Choji’s darkening, Togame’s self-blame and Umemiya’s broad-mindedness so well.

Habit change depends on space located, and cues in front.

Four Steps of Habit Functioning  —  Habit Loop #

Let’s review “Definition” and “Goal” of habit first 👇

  • Definition: So-called habit, is behavior repeated enough times to be automated
  • Goal: Solve problems in life with “least energy and effort”.

Then specifically, how does “constant repetition” achieve “automation”, and further become a habit?

item.title: Re-understanding Habits — "Atomic Habits" Book Digest (Part 1)
item.description:
Note: This post is translated by AI. If you find any unnatural phrasing or errors, please feel free to contact me via email or other channels. Your feedback is appreciated!

Preface #

This book teaches not psychological techniques of “self-motivation” or “strengthening willpower”, but how to still achieve your goals when willpower is insufficient.

In the modern age where smartphones reign supreme, people find it increasingly difficult to resist temptations on their own. After all, these temptations (such as TV series, mobile games, etc.) are readily available, and there are countless people behind them meticulously designing to make us fall. Speaking for myself, I love reading manga and watching anime very much. Often chase a whole season at once, sacrificing sleep time or whole weekend. Original planned things were not finished, can only hate myself more and more day after day.
